title: Generating Images and Diffusion Models
lead: Covers: image generation (Stable Diffusion, VAEs, GANs, restoration, scene reconstruction), colourisation in the Lab colour space, the U-Net autoencoder with skip connections (code, shapes, training, inference) from the assignment, and an introductory background on how diffusion models, GANs and VAEs work. Note: your folder has no slides on diffusion, so that part is clearly marked as background. No prior lecture attendance needed.
